purpose: Visual design proposals, pending user review. No runtime integration.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original high-quality pixel-art INVENTORY ITEM ATLAS for Agents Bar, a premium medieval fantasy desktop RPG. This is an art proposal, not a UI screenshot. Landscape canvas, EXACTLY SIX different isolated items in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid with equal cells and generous empty gutters, centers at 1/6, 1/2, 5/6 horizontally and 1/4, 3/4 vertically. Each item fits wholly inside its own cell with 20% clear padding. Genuinely transparent background everywhere outside items. NO text, NO labels, NO numbers, NO frames, NO UI slots, NO characters, NO scenery, NO ground shadows. Polished hand-crafted 16-bit inventory aesthetic, sharply defined visible square pixel clusters, approximately a 64x64 source sprite per item enlarged by nearest neighbor; no blur, no antialias, no photorealistic material, no smooth gradients. Rich carefully controlled 20-32 color palette: bright steel silver, slate-blue shadows, warm antique gold hardware, royal-blue cloth, cyan crystal highlights, occasional muted verdant accents. Strong dark selective outlines, restrained pixel highlights, consistent upper-left light and three-quarter view. Distinct silhouettes instantly readable at inventory size. Detailed but not noisy. Match a silver plate knight with a closed visor, blue plume, gilded belt and ornate shield in a dark navy and antique-gold RPG interface. Do not copy any existing game item. WEAPONS atlas. Left-to-right top row: (1) refined straight knight longsword with silver blade, gold crossguard, blue leather grip, diagonal tip upper-right; (2) heavy single-bladed battle axe for a forge guardian, dark steel head, copper-gold fittings and tiny orange ember in head; (3) compact square-headed smith warhammer, silver face, gold bands, navy grip. Bottom row: (4) recurved wood-and-gold ranger bow with blue string and one visible nocked arrow; (5) botanical mage staff, gnarled pale wood, gold fitting, green crystal cradled by two leaves, clear staff silhouette; (6) storm spear with elongated silver leaf-shaped point, blue wrapped shaft and restrained cyan rune. Make all six weapons iconic and structurally believable. Full weapons visible including tips and handles.

RELICS atlas corresponding to six actual game relics.
